Script.name: CF_Loader
Script.script:
function downloadPkg(a,b) if installRequested then return end echo("****Downloading package.") downloadFile(getMudletHomeDir() .. "/CFGUI.zip", "https://mudlet-cdn.carrionfields.net/cfgui/latest/CFGUI.zip") end
function downloadFailed(event, message, file) if file ~= getMudletHomeDir().."/CFGUI.zip" then return end cecho("\r\n<maroon>*<gold> Your Carrion Fields client could not be downloaded: <gray>"..tostring(message).."\r\n") cecho([[<gold>To download the Carrion Fields Mudlet client, please copy and paste the following code into the command line:
lua function d(a,b)if not b:find("CFGUI",1,true)then return end installPackage(b)os.remove(b)cecho("<lime_green>Package installed!\n")end registerAnonymousEventHandler("sysDownloadDone","d")downloadFile(getMudletHomeDir().."/CFGUI.zip","https://mudlet-cdn.carrionfields.net/cfgui/latest/CFGUI.zip")
]]) end
function installReady(event, file) if file ~= getMudletHomeDir().."/CFGUI.zip" then return end
cecho([[
<maroon>*<gold> Your Carrion Fields client was successfully downloaded.
]]) cecho("\r\n<maroon>*<gold> Installing... <gray>(this will take a few seconds.)\r\n") installRequested = true tempTimer(2, function() local installedBefore = #getPackages() local ok, err = installPackage(getMudletHomeDir().."/CFGUI.zip") if not ok then installRequested = false cecho("\r\n<maroon>*<gold> Installing your Carrion Fields client failed: <gray>"..tostring(err).."\r\n") elseif #getPackages() == installedBefore then installRequested = false end end) uninstallPackage("CF_Loader") end
registerAnonymousEventHandler("sysConnectionEvent", "downloadPkg") registerAnonymousEventHandler("sysDownloadDone", "installReady") registerAnonymousEventHandler("sysDownloadError", "downloadFailed")
